title: Entity
description: A thing in the ecosystem. Faceted, multi-layer (TAXONOMY.md §1, Finding 1). IDs are permanent; names are not.

aliases.description: Mandatory for anything ever called something else, including informal community names. Renaming is routine in this ecosystem.

facets.description: Role-specific structured properties. Validated per-role by data/schema/facets/<role>.schema.json.

tokenizer_generation.description: ADDED M4.1 (S2). Identifier for the tokenizer generation this model uses. null means UNKNOWN, never 'same as sibling models' — exp-tokenizer-normalization-v1 H3 found within-vendor generational drift up to 1.27x, so tokenizers must not be assumed to carry across a vendor's product line.

tokenizer_verified.description: ADDED M4.1 (S2). True only when the tokenizer has been empirically measured or explicitly documented for THIS model. Vendor statements of the form 'version X and later' do not verify a specific model that is not named.

tokenizer_repo.description: Exact repo/encoding used for measurement, where one is publicly available. null for vendors publishing no offline tokenizer.

summary.description: Placement, not evaluation. Deliberately too small to hold unsourced opinion; evaluation belongs in scores and claims.

decision_questions.description: The questions this entity exists to answer (CONSTITUTION §1).

relationships.description: Edges stored on the subject; inverses materialized at build time (GRAPH.md §2).

provides.description: Convenience index of capability edges. Generated from relationships; authoring it directly fails validation.

slots.description: Stack positions this entity can fill (RECOMMENDATION.md §2). Derived from roles unless overridden.

open_questions.description: Known unknowns. Surfaced in the gap register rather than hidden.

claims.description: An active entity with no claims is an unsourced assertion that it matters.

relationships.description: Retired entities are retained with a succession edge where one exists (TAXONOMY.md §6 rule 7). Waived case-by-case when nothing succeeded it.
